_about: Opt-in ecosystem proof-of-life published by the Conduit project. This file is the ONLY source the public /stats page reads. It contains ONLY data the project chooses to publish about its OWN instances — nothing is collected from other operators, and no private ledger data appears here. Defaults are minimal; add aggregate fields below only if you deliberately choose to share them.
highlights: First real mainnet Lightning payment settled end-to-end

aggregates._note: OFF by default. To publish ecosystem volume, add e.g. "payments_settled": 1234 and "volume_sats": 5678900 here. Left empty so nothing is over-claimed.
